title: xDrip+ can work on a Xiaomi with MIUI 10.3.10 (Android 9)?
body:
Hi all.
I'm obliged to change my Android 7 phone, and I chose the Xiaomi Redmi Note 7, using a Xiaomi modified Android 9, named **MIUI 10.3.10**.
My doubt is that, having seen that many smartphones had big problems with Android 9, this one could not be working with xDrip+.
I would like to know if someone uses phones with this IO, and if he had problems.
Thanks a lot.
Bye.
Pippo      :-)

comments.body:
Sorry, I forgot to inform you that I use Freestyle Libre (14 days EU) and Miaomiao 1.
Pippo

Hello Andre,

No problem with my 14 days EU LIBRE + MiaoMiao2 with xdrip+ ( last build ) on my Xiaomi Redmi note 5 Pro, but i use Omnirom ( not Miui )

Thank you Okanami, but this doesn't solve my doubts, sorry. 
Hope someone else using MIUI 10.3.10 will do it.
Bye and thank again, anyway.
Pippo
